name: dasel-output-representability-reports-and-58db
instr:
dasel cannot inspect whether a model value is representable by an output format before serialization. Add deterministic, path-aware planning to the Go API and CLI, with permissive, lossless, and strict enforcement. When enforcement is not requested, preserve existing output and error behavior.

Planning must be non-emitting and non-mutating, reporting every unsupported or lossy operation at its exact typed traversal identity, including map keys, slice indexes, and logical document indexes, in stable traversal order. Apply this behavior to every registered structured writer: CSV, INI, HCL, XML, KDL, TOML, JSON, and YAML. Match each writer's root handling, recursive conversions, metadata, ordering, options, and format restrictions.

Branch and spread planning must produce one ordered report while retaining logical document identity. Expose identical reports and severity decisions through the public Go API and CLI using `--output-policy`. Policy rejection must return every deterministic finding before emitting bytes and leave the value reusable. Without enforcement, preserve successful writer and CLI bytes, separators, ordering, and write-error classifications.

Package `github.com/tomwright/dasel/v3/model` exposes `ValuePath`, `ValuePath.String`, and `NewValuePath`; package `github.com/tomwright/dasel/v3/parsing` exposes `OutputSeverity`, `OutputPolicy`, `OutputIssue`, `OutputReport`, `OutputReport.Allowed`, `Writer.Plan`, `Format.NewWriter`, `OutputPolicyError`, and `ApplyOutp
